assumptions.statement: Content Store is the sole consumer of the api-mongo cluster, meaning no other applications depend on it.
assumptions.quote: The only application that uses the api-mongo cluster is Content Store.

assumptions.statement: The main application mongo cluster has sufficient capacity to handle the additional load from Content Store without becoming a single point of failure for the entire stack.
assumptions.quote: All other applications use the mongo cluster.

assumptions.statement: The router-backend cluster must remain independent due to the critical nature of the Router application, implying it cannot be merged with the main mongo cluster.
assumptions.quote: The router-backend cluster is used by Router. This should remain independent due to the critical nature of this application.
